The biggest lesson of the AI era: never get comfortable.

On June 2nd, IBM, 
$IBM
, was up +13% for the year and trading at its highest level on record.

Today, just 42 days later, 
$IBM
 fell -25% posting its biggest daily decline since 1968.

The stock is now down -35% in 42 days
